desc: Establish the canonical structure: required mismatches flip once; common `1→1` coordinates may be cycled once; common `0→0` remain off.
Derive ordering: removals precede additions, removals sort by decreasing `C`, additions by increasing `C`, and cycled common-one weights form a decreasing prefix.
Correct the addition-phase baseline and validate the `O(N log N)` prefix-enumeration implementation against all samples.
Verify integer bounds and finalize Python stdin/stdout code.
